text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Nutrition is the foundation of everything. 
The secret behind an Umamusume's sturdy 
body must lie in food.
choice_data_list: That's why we need to do research!
That's why we need to do research!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Can it stand up against the great carrots 
of Funabashi? Let me witness your 
"cuisine".

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, this is delicious! Tracen Academy's 
carrot dishes really are the best!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
I cannot let that slide... As a proud 
citizen of Funabashi, where carrots are 
our branded local specialty.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Above all, it tastes great! The sweetness 
is exquisite... and the texture is so 
soft... Simply irresistible!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
You really don't get it, do you~? Even the 
presentation of the dish is absolute 
perfection!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. Please do not misunderstand. This 
is not the sound of me being charmed by 
the JRA.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
So to speak, it is a conch shell blown 
before battle. A declaration of war, you 
could say.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
There's no way you could ever impress 
someone with refined tastes developed in 
Funabashi like me—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Not only does it taste great, but the 
nutritional balance is perfect for racing 
and training. Its color, its aroma—there's 
simply... no fault to find!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Just as the two of them said, it is as 
close to "perfection" as one could get, 
indeed.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: ...Damn it! Curse you, URA!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, let's eat more! The secret to the 
Central's strength must be right here!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"I'll eat until my stomach bursts... and 
find it for sure!!"
choice_data_list:
Eat a bunch and research the cuisine at 
the Tracen Center!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Hah! ...Forgive me. I was about to fall 
straight into the central trap.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
That's right. What matters is the race. As 
long as we prove the Chuo wrong on the 
track, that's enough.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
No matter how high the quality of their 
meals is... I will definitely not lose to 
them.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, Furioso headed toward the 
training grounds at a brisk pace.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
I ordered everything in sight. Now then, 
let us begin our research into the 
Central's carrot cuisine.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: When I do something, I go all the way!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Heaping plates of carrot dishes were 
brought to Furioso one after another, and 
she polished them all off with an utterly 
serious look in her eyes.
